title: A must-do in Barcelona! Highly recommended!
text: A highly recommended tour! We did the tour as a family and the tour guide was incredibly nice! It was not an 08/15, but you noticed that a lot of time and love goes into the tour. The restaurants that were chosen were super delicious and you could empathize with the Spanish feeling! Also the informative part has not been neglected! We learned a lot about Barcelona, which was really exciting and interesting. It is a super nice tour that I can recommend to anyone.
author: annabI544DF

title: Gran tarde, Gran guia, Comida deleciosa
text: We had a wonderful afternoon with great food and a great guide who knows so much about Barcelona and talks entertainingly. Time has passed far too quickly. Vielen Dank Christian.
author: 485katjaw

title: Just perfect
text: The guide was great. He was very friendly, had a great knowledge of the city and the culinary leadership was also very successful.
author: 354lassew

title: Don't Miss This Tour!
text: Our guide, Christian, was prompt, knowledgable and had a wonderful personality.  We were a group of 8 people and the tour became private.  The food stops provided tastings of different types of foods and were of high quality and generous.  We can't say enough about this wonderful tour!  We decide to do a walking tour after our flight landed in the morning (so we could stay awake during the day and better adjust to the time difference). author: Julie_A

title: Best for solo travelers
text: This is my first time to do a guided tour with Airbnb and I am so happy that I tried something new. Unlike any other organized tours I did in the past, my time with Christian was informative, engaging, and heartwarming. I LOVED it. It was like spending quality time with a good friend who showed me around the town where you wouldn’t get to see on your own. He is genuine, knowledgeable, open-minded, and considerate. title: We will definately repeat!
text: Our experience with Christian was outstanding! His knowledge of Barcelona´s history was impressive and the way he explained us the secret spots was entertaning and very refreshing! Even though we have been to Barcelona a few times before, we still discovered new favourite places. The highlight was the food. Christian took us out to a couple of nice traditional restaurants with a pleasant ambience and provided us with explanations about the menu. Always considering our personal preferences. author: P231MTlaural

title: Great food AND learning
text: My wife and I really enjoyed the evening with Christian! Far more than just a food tour, we got an introduction to several neighborhoods in Barcelona and lots of interesting history. And the food was great! This experience is a great value and we highly recommend.
author: 360rong

title: So much fun!
text: Christian and Michael were an absolute delight, so kind & knowledgeable! This experience was a last-minute booking for us and far exceeded our expectations. The walking tour with history/story-telling and the tapas & restaurant stops were incredible. We loved our time together and highly recommend this experience to others
author: KateKelley04

title: Excellent
text: Lovely combination to discover Barcelona! We spent a great time with our guide Michael who showed us beautiful historic spots in the old town. His story telling was fascinating and he explained us many details about the Spanish food during the three stops. We particularly loved the pintxos! All the restaurants were well selected. We had a wonderful time! Thank you!
author: RodyAndersonn
